scope_note: Second-pass public-evidence audit for the State Farm data center at 24400 West Valley Parkway in Olathe, Kansas. The account adds two official City permit values and SEC-reported property area, occupancy and critical-IT-load snapshots while keeping permit values, estimated cumulative capital spending, parcel assessments, tax bills and tax payments as distinct measures. The search trail covers parcel and fiscal records, construction and suppliers, operations and workforce, incentives, utility and environmental regulation, community activity, planning, public costs and county outcomes. No site-level employment, payroll, supplier payment, community transfer, metered electricity or water, incentive amount, marginal public-service cost, net fiscal position or attributable county effect is inferred from public material.

project_updates.title: Project boundary, ownership and operating chronology audit
project_updates.notes: SEC filings from 2017 and 2025, Johnson County parcel records, City planning materials and FCC records were reconciled by 24400 West Valley Parkway, the State Farm Data Center name, SFDC Cedar Creek, quick reference R662349 and tax ID DP69210000 0001. They establish a single approximately 20-acre property built in 2016, State Farm possession by early 2017, later HMC Data Center 2 LLC parcel ownership and continuing State Farm tenancy. Financing borrowers, parcel owners and operator are not conflated, and no neighboring U.S. Bank facility or wider two-property State Farm portfolio amount is assigned here.
project_updates.project_description: State Farm Olathe is a single-tenant data center operated by State Farm Mutual Automobile Insurance Company at 24400 West Valley Parkway in Olathe, Johnson County, Kansas. City permit records document new construction in 2015 and a tenant finish in 2017, while SEC filings say the 193,953-square-foot facility was built in 2016, the lease began November 3, 2016, and State Farm occupied the property by early 2017. This account covers the single approximately 20-acre parcel and its building, not State Farm's wider portfolio, later unverified expansion, tenant equipment, or neighboring data centers.

project_updates.title: Construction and permit-value audit
project_updates.notes: City annual permit reports, planning files and indexed permit histories were searched for 2015-2026 by BC15-0148, BC17-0041, SFDC Cedar Creek, State Farm, Kansas City Data Center and the exact address. Official reports support separate $81,555,000 new-construction and $28,000,000 tenant-finish permit values. These administrative values are neither verified expenditures nor safely additive to each other or the SEC's $169,778,850 estimated cumulative capital figure; no worker hours, construction payroll, schedule, equipment split or realized construction job count was found.

project_updates.title: Supplier and procurement audit — participants found, payments absent
project_updates.notes: Official permit reports and indexed contractor, architect and engineer materials were searched for State Farm Olathe, Kansas City Data Center, Corgan, GBA Builders, U.S. Engineering, supplier, vendor, contract and payment. A secondary permit index associates Corgan with foundation work, but its value is excluded because primary provenance and overlap are unresolved. No contract amount, paid supplier total, vendor address at payment time or Johnson County local-retention share was found, and no permit value is allocated among suppliers.

project_updates.title: Parcel, fiscal-revenue and public-cost audit
project_updates.notes: Johnson County assessor and treasurer records were rechecked for R662349 and DP69210000 0001, including 2021-2025 values and 2019-2025 bills, paid amounts and balances. Olathe ACFRs, budgets, agendas and financing materials were searched for State Farm, JDM III, HMC Data Center 2, the address and project-specific service or infrastructure cost. Parcel taxes span several recipients; no recipient allocation, marginal police, fire, road, utility, administrative or debt cost, reimbursement total or same-scope net fiscal position was found.

project_updates.title: State and local incentive audit — no project award amount located
project_updates.notes: Kansas Commerce transparency, PEAK and HPIP materials, Kansas Revenue tax-expenditure reports, City financial and agenda records and indexed bond records were searched by State Farm, Kansas City Data Center, JDM III SF Kansas City DC, HMC Data Center 2 and the exact address. No project-specific executed award, certified job or investment commitment, claimed tax benefit, local abatement schedule, bond subsidy or counterfactual tax amount was located. General program rules and later data-center legislation are not treated as evidence that this 2015-2017 project received a benefit.

project_updates.title: Electricity, utility and resource-consumption audit
project_updates.notes: KCC current and archived dockets, City utility pages, SEC facility descriptions, operator environmental reports and indexed utility materials were searched for 2015-2026 by operator, address, owner entities, service agreement, tariff, load, electricity, water, wastewater, PUE and renewable terms. SEC filings support only 6.66 MW and 7.5 MW critical-IT-load capacity snapshots. No utility identity supported by a primary site record, special contract, observed demand, annual kWh, power bill, measured PUE, metered water, wastewater volume, rate class or account payment was found; capacity is not converted to consumption.

project_updates.title: Environmental, generator and emergency-response audit
project_updates.notes: FCC, regional emergency-planning, EPA ECHO, Kansas environmental and indexed air, fuel, generator and discharge records were searched using the facility name and exact address. The FCC grant documents communications equipment and the regional plan identifies the site, but neither supplies generator count, fuel storage, run hours, emissions, discharge, resource consumption, incident history or attributable emergency-response cost. A 2016 Phase I statement in the SEC filing is environmental due diligence, not operating-performance evidence.

project_updates.title: Operations and workforce audit — facility capacity found, labor totals absent
project_updates.notes: SEC filings, State Farm careers and impact materials, City economic-development records and indexed job postings were searched for 2015-2026 by Olathe, exact address, data center, employee, contractor, technician, wage, payroll and residency. The filings establish area, tenant occupancy, operating chronology and critical IT load. No realized State Farm or contractor FTE, annual payroll, wage distribution, worker residence, operating purchase or facility revenue was public; a third-party technician vacancy is neither realized headcount nor a representative facility wage.

project_updates.title: Community and nonprofit-recipient audit — no facility transfer found
project_updates.notes: State Farm community-grant, impact, volunteer and press materials and indexed Olathe, Johnson County, school, nonprofit, first-responder, donation and grant results were searched for facility attribution, recipient, date and amount. No cash grant, in-kind value or volunteer-hour total tied to the Olathe data center was found. Company-wide giving, activity by local insurance agents and similarly named out-of-state State Farm data-center projects are excluded.

project_updates.title: Planning, expansion and strategic-infrastructure audit
project_updates.notes: City planning, zoning, annual development reports, Legistar packets, transportation and infrastructure references were searched by address, SFDC Cedar Creek and operator or owner names. The public record supports the original building and later tenant finish and confirms that the area already includes another data center. No separately bounded State Farm expansion, publicly funded road or utility improvement, quantified strategic benefit, fiber subsidy or State Farm-specific infrastructure reimbursement was located.

project_updates.title: County outcomes and modeling-eligibility audit
project_updates.notes: The repository's 2001-2024 Johnson County BEA and BLS GDP, employment and wage series were reviewed alongside project chronology and nearby data-center context. No project-specific treatment exposure series, first-county-entry evidence, uncontaminated comparison set, pretrend diagnostic, placebo or robustness result supports a State Farm-attributable county effect. Missing construction labor, operations labor, suppliers, community transfers, actual resource use, incentives and public costs also lack cited site-allocation parameters, so no multiplier, utility, net-fiscal, break-even or causal model is added merely to complete categories.
